decisions.reason: As an adjacent automation product in a growing and investing firm, its early market presence is likely close enough to aspiration levels that management would retain it while using available slack to learn from initial adoption.

Because it builds on the established loading-system business and fits the firm's application know-how and service base, management would likely keep it unless clear underperformance emerges beyond this short initial launch period.

Although more distant from the core offer and therefore riskier relative to aspirations, its flagship status and visible external recognition give management reason to continue supporting it rather than abandon it after only one year.
